ViewDef.Title: NSX Federation - Locations
ViewDef.Description: State of each location of the federation.

ViewDef.Title: NSX Federation - Sync channels
ViewDef.Description: Connections between the managers of the federation.

ViewDef.Title: NSX Federation - RTEP tunnels
ViewDef.Description: Inter-site tunnels between edge nodes, with rates.

ViewDef.Title: NSX Federation - Tier-0 BGP neighbors
ViewDef.Description: BGP sessions of the stretched Tier-0 gateways.

ViewDef.Title: NSX Federation - Edge capacity
ViewDef.Description: CPU, memory and disk of the federation edge nodes.

ViewDef.Title: NSX Federation - Tier-0 service routers
ViewDef.Description: HA state and routing of each stretched Tier-0 gateway on each edge.

ViewDef.Title: NSX Federation - Recent changes
ViewDef.Description: The changes the collection saw, newest first.

ViewDef.Title: NSX Federation - Firewall rule review
ViewDef.Description: Rules of the global security policies to review: disabled, shadowed by an earlier rule, unused, or allowing any traffic.

ViewDef.Title: NSX Federation - Realization per location
ViewDef.Description: Each stretched object at each location of its span.

ViewDef.Title: NSX Federation - Availability of the federation
ViewDef.Description: Share of the last 30 days with exactly one active Global Manager answering, so that global configuration can change.

ViewDef.Title: NSX Federation - Availability of the Global Managers
ViewDef.Description: Share of the last 30 days each Global Manager was reachable with no node offline.

ViewDef.Title: NSX Federation - Availability of the locations
ViewDef.Description: Share of the last 30 days each location was healthy: connected to the active Global Manager, reached by the collector, no node offline, inter-site BGP up and full sync complete.

ViewDef.Title: NSX Federation - Availability of the Tier-0 gateways
ViewDef.Description: Share of the last 30 days each stretched Tier-0 had an active service router where its HA mode needs one, and the number of service router HA changes (failovers).

Property.name: displayName
Property.value: Locations without an active SR, most

ReportDef.Title: NSX Federation - Health report
ReportDef.Description: Locations, sync channels, RTEP tunnels, Tier-0 BGP neighbors, edge capacity, Tier-0 service routers, firewall rule review, recent changes and the realization of stretched objects.

ReportDef.Title: NSX Federation - Availability report
ReportDef.Description: Availability over the last 30 days of the federation, the Global Managers, the locations and the stretched Tier-0 gateways, with the failovers. Schedule it monthly on the federation object.
